names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 5 aprilie, «Sfântul Mucenic Agatopod».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 4 Απριλίου, «Άγιοι Θεόδουλος και Αγαθάπους», with the rank word left off. The life page spells the same name Ἀγαθόπους in its couplet and Άγαθάποδας in its prose.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 5 aprilie — «Sfântul Mucenic Agatopod»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Θεόδουλος και Αγαθάπους»

attestations.note: The Greek calendar keeps the pair on 4 April, a day earlier than the Romanian 5 April this folder already records; the life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους». The page puts them «στα πρώτα χρόνια των διωγμών» and gives no year, so no dates are recorded from it. It spells his name three ways on one page — Αγαθάπους in the day's line, Ἀγαθόπους in the couplet, Άγαθάποδας in the prose — and prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinţilor Mucenici Teodul şi Agatopod, Glasul 4 (the page's «nesctricăciunii» is the reading printed there)

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contest received incorruptible crowns from thee, our God; for having thy strength they overcame the tormentors, and they broke also the feeble insolence of the demons. By their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.
